purpose: Freeze the authoritative inputs and ownership boundaries for Skin Stage 1 without reopening Hero Stage 5-5 skin semantics.

canonicalHeroIdentity.reuseRule: Reuse the existing canonical Hero identity. Do not rebuild playable-Hero population or name identity in Skin Stage 1.

heroSkinSourceTrace.role: Authoritative source/JOIN semantics for regular Hero skins, artwork resources, source order and acquisition encoding.

heroSkinOutputContract.role: Accepted per-Hero normalized skin shape and ownership boundaries.

heroSkinFinalGate.role: Frozen upstream completion gate and regression baseline.

frozenRelations.orderingRule: Preserve source array order exactly. Do not re-sort by skinId, Score, store UISort or acquisition category.

populationScope.includedDefinition: Canonical regular Hero skins already accepted by Hero Stage 5-5 through HeroInfo.Skins_ID[].

excluded.baseHeroArtwork: Owned by ConfigDataCharImageInfo.HeroPainting; not a regular skin record.
excluded.spHeroIllustration: Owned by Hero Stage 5-4 SP data; do not synthesize SP illustration switching into the regular skin master.
excluded.soldierSkins: Out of scope for this Hero skin pipeline.
excluded.unprovenSpecialAssets: Do not admit assets merely because filenames or folders contain skin-like terms.

acquisitionPolicy.rule: Missing GetPathType is a source-data gap, not an acquisition category. Do not infer event/store/acquisition history in Stage 1.

ownershipBoundaries.skinStage1: Canonical population admission and Skin-domain checkpointing only.
ownershipBoundaries.heroStage5_5: Upstream authority for accepted regular skin membership, owner relation, source order, source image path, source Spine path and encoded acquisition semantics.
ownershipBoundaries.heroStage5_4: Authority for SP existence, SP illustration switching, SP missions and SP-specific page data.
ownershipBoundaries.assetPipeline: Extraction, conversion, hashing and web-serving output paths are deferred to Skin Stage 3.
ownershipBoundaries.releaseMetadata: CN/KR release dates, KR future status, Korean skin names and supplemental acquisition history are deferred to Skin Stage 4.
ownershipBoundaries.futureSkinConsumer: Future-skin-page eligibility must not be decided in Stage 1; it is derived only after release metadata is available.

prohibitions: Do not rescan raw Asset folders to redefine the canonical regular skin population.
Do not rebuild Hero identity or playable-Hero filtering.
Do not infer Hero ownership from skin names, filenames, folder names or numeric ID patterns.
Do not sort skins by skinId, Score, FixedStoreItemInfo.UISort or acquisition category.
Do not treat missing GetPathType as a single acquisition category.
Do not classify SP artwork as a regular Hero skin.
Do not assign HERO_PAGE_ONLY, FUTURE_SKIN_PAGE, BOTH or HIDDEN before release/admission metadata is established.
Do not perform asset extraction/conversion or frontend consumer generation in Stage 1-0.
completionRule: Skin Stage 1-0 is complete when this contract is committed and all referenced upstream artifacts exist on the same repository snapshot with the accepted Hero Stage 5-5 baseline intact.
nextAction: Skin 1-1: materialize the 540 accepted regular Hero skins as the Skin-domain canonical population without changing the frozen upstream semantics.
